tools.name: calculate_paycheck
tools.description: Compute a US paycheck for 2026: gross, each tax and pre-tax deduction, and take-home pay per paycheck and per year, for a salary or an hourly rate (overtime over 40 hours at 1.5 times) in any state or DC. tools.name: compare_states
tools.description: Take-home pay for the same salary in the 50 states and DC in 2026, sorted from the highest. Useful to answer "which state lets me keep the most" or to price a move.

tools.name: calculate_bonus_tax
tools.description: What a bonus check pays after the flat 22% federal supplemental withholding, FICA and state tax, and how much of the federal withholding comes back (or is still owed) at tax time, on top of a salary, 2026 rules (IRS Pub. 15).
